headline: Black founders, open bias tools, public engagement lessons
digest: Amii will deliver AI literacy and machine-learning cohorts to young Black founders through the African Canadian Civic Engagement Council's ANZA 2.0 program over five years. Vector released UnBias-Plus, a free open-source tool that detects and rewrites biased language in text and datasets. In the UK, Connected by Data wrapped up a two-year community of practice on public engagement with data and AI.
